lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately five distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Each column contains 3-4 primary centroids within the mid-lateral field of view.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with these circular blobs to create a highly regularized grid-like lattice across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, marked by a sharp increase in pixel luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge transitioning to a darker shadow gradient immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) visible as elongated, low-luminance silhouettes clustered around the posterior edge and base of the pectoral fin.
